name: deep-review
description: The deep-review plugin, served from the committed build output under dist/

plugins.name: deep-review
plugins.description: Deep review of one change by the deep-review engine, a Node program installed with this plugin: a Markdown report with the evidence and the engine's own decision on every finding, only the questions a person must answer, the fixes that depart from a rule, and what the run did not examine, and on request the fixes applied by its workers with the project's checks run, committing nothing.
